nodes.title: CLIP Text Encode (Positive Prompt)
widgets_values: This is a highly detailed, close-up photograph of a fair-skinned woman with striking, vibrant red hair styled in loose, wavy curls. She has a symmetrical face with a delicate, heart-shaped jawline and high cheekbones. Her skin is smooth with a natural, dewy finish, showcasing a generous scattering of freckles across her nose and cheeks, which adds a charming, youthful quality. Her light blue eyes are softly focused, with long, dark eyelashes framing them. Her lips are full and naturally pink, with a glossy finish. She wears a thick, cream-colored scarf that covers her neck and shoulders, suggesting a cold climate or a fashion statement. The background is a clear, bright blue sky, devoid of any clouds, emphasizing her as the focal point. The lighting is soft and natural, enhancing her delicate features and creating a serene, almost ethereal atmosphere. The overall composition and style of the photograph are elegant and minimalist, with a focus on natural beauty and simplicity.

nodes.title: CLIP Text Encode (Negative Prompt)
widgets_values: 低分辨率，低画质，肢体畸形，手指畸形，画面过饱和，蜡像感，人脸无细节，过度光滑，画面具有AI感。构图混乱。文字模糊，扭曲。

Low resolution, poor image quality, distorted limbs and fingers, oversaturated colors, waxy appearance, lack of detail in faces, overly smooth textures, and an overall artificial/AI-generated look. The composition is chaotic. Text is blurry and distorted.

A close-up portrait of a young woman with fair skin and freckles looks directly at the viewer against a pale blue sky. Her vibrant red hair is pulled back into an elegant braid that rests over her forehead, while small curls frame her face. She has striking light-blue eyes and full lips coated in a natural-looking matte nude lip gloss. The model's gaze is calm yet engaging, suggesting confidence and poise as she holds a gentle but direct look forward. A thick white knitted turtleneck sweater covers her shoulders, its textured fabric softly framing her neck and adding warmth to the image. Her head is slightly tilted, creating a subtle asymmetry in her posture which enhances the intimate feel of the shot. The photograph captures strong sunlight from above, casting minimal shadow on her features and highlighting their smooth contours under bright, even illumination. This high-contrast daylight creates vivid highlights across her cheeks and nose while keeping her complexion luminous without harsh glare. Taken from a low angle just below eye level, this tight crop emphasizes her delicate facial structure and gives prominence to both her expressive eyes and the intricate texture of her garment. The shallow depth-of-field blurs the distant horizon behind her, drawing all attention to her serene presence within the simple backdrop of open skies.
